title: Dashboard first-run empty state: guide new operators with one actionable message instead of a blank screen
goal: When an operator opens AegisPT for the first time (no engagements, no runs, no findings), the Dashboard screen shows little to no content — tiles are empty or absent, leaving operators with no clear next step. The Dashboard empty state should show: (1) a welcome message with a one-line description of what AegisPT does, (2) a single primary call-to-action button: 'Start Your First Assessment' that navigates to the wizard, (3) optionally: three summary tiles showing '0 Active Runs', '0 Open Findings', '0 Engagements' with muted styling to establish the layout pattern without being misleading. The existing setup checklist (when visible) covers onboarding; this task addresses the empty dashboard layout specifically when the checklist is dismissed or not shown.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Dashboard screen (screen-dashboard, dashboard-content div) shows a near-blank screen when no engagements or runs exist. New operators have no guidance on what to do. The screen-copy says 'Track the active run, risk posture, open problems, schedule, recent activity, and setup readiness' but none of these items exist to track, so the screen feels broken.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Dashboard blank for new operators — needs actionable empty state with clear first step.

When engagements exist but no active run: Dashboard shows engagement/run summary tiles (existing behavior, not broken).
Empty state button navigates to the wizard screen.
No regression in Dashboard E2E tests.
